warrior.spell_restrictions: Can learn open lists of one realm (chosen by the player). Can only cast spells of level 1, 2 and 3.

scout.spell_restrictions: Can learn open lists from one realm (chosen by the player). Can only cast spells of level 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5.

ranger.spell_restrictions: Can learn open lists of Channeling spells and ranger spell lists, however can only cast spells of level 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 from the open Channeling lists (no limit on their ranger lists).

mage.spell_restrictions: Can learn open lists of Essence spells and mage spell lists.

animist.spell_restrictions: Can learn open lists of Channeling spells and animist spell lists.

bard.spell_restrictions: Can learn open lists of Essence spells and bard spell lists. However, can only cast spells of level 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 from the open Essence lists (no limit on the open bard lists).
